post.description: Owner admin ve altını, admin yalnızca manager ve altını davet eder (403 members.role_not_grantable). E-posta başına tek bekleyen davet (409 invitation.already_pending, invitationId ile); zaten üye olan adres 409 members.already_member. max_users = aktif üye + açık davet (403 entitlement.limit_exceeded). No e-mail is sent: the response carries the invitation token once (only its SHA-256 is stored, and the response is not kept for Idempotency-Key replay, so this call takes no Idempotency-Key). Share it with the invitee manually.

post.description: The text is masked (phone numbers, e-mail addresses) and parsed by the AI parser when it is enabled, configured and within the tenant's daily quota; otherwise — and on any provider error, timeout, refusal or invalid output — by the deterministic rules parser (fallbackReason + warnings say which and why). Lines are matched only against the tenant's own catalog: matched lines carry one proposal, ambiguous lines up to 5 candidates and no proposal, unmatched lines none. 429 `ai.rate_limited` (with Retry-After) when the hourly parse limit is reached. Needs the AI assistant add-on (403 `entitlement.required`, feature `ai_order_parsing`); 403 `entitlement.limit_exceeded` when the add-on's monthly parse quota (`ai_parses_per_month`) is used up. Reviewing, approving and rejecting stored parses stay open without the add-on.

CodeConflictProblemDetails.description: 409 catalog.sku_taken / catalog.barcode_taken: conflict names the existing variant holding the value (absent when only the database index caught a concurrent write).

EntitlementProblemDetails.description: 403: auth.forbidden / auth.disabled_by_tenant_rule (permission), or entitlement.required (feature names the missing feature; suggestedPlan / suggestedModule what would grant it, null when nothing in the catalog does) and entitlement.limit_exceeded (feature names the limit; limit and current are the numbers). Existing data stays readable.

StockProblemDetails.description: Stock problem: shortages per line (insufficient stock) and confirmationRequired (negative-stock policy 'warn' — retry with the confirmation flag).
